reviews.comment:
Nos encanta comer ahí. La atención es buena, las chicas le ponen toda la onda. El único problema que tiene es el horario, cierra a las 22hs y la cocina a las 21:30hs. Una ridiculez manejar ese horario cuando se trabaja para gente que viaja. Además no es parte de la red full de YPF por lo que no podés usar tus puntos ni acumularlos. Una pena….

(Translated by Google)
We love eating there. The service is good, the girls are really friendly. The only problem is the hours; it closes at 10 pm and the kitchen closes at 9:30 pm. It's ridiculous to have those hours when you're catering to people who travel. Also, it's not part of the YPF full network, so you can't use your points or accumulate them. What a shame…
